items.label: FIGURE O.15
items.title: Positive relationship between income levels and GHG emissions

panel_a.title: Ten economies produce two-thirds of global emissions

panel_b.title: Emissions per capita are converging between high- and upper-middle-income countries

trends.High-income: Starts at approx. 14 t CO2e in 2000, shows a gradual downward trend to approx. 12 t CO2e by 2022.
trends.Upper-middle-income: Starts at approx. 4 t CO2e in 2000, shows a steady upward trend to approx. 8 t CO2e by 2022.
trends.Lower-middle-income: Remains relatively flat at approx. 2-3 t CO2e throughout the period.
trends.Low-income: Remains flat at approx. 1-2 t CO2e throughout the period.
